boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Huntingdon corridors near Juniata College, each paired with one directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Settle In With a Library Book
cards.subtitle: Penn Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Penn Street corridor to browse the collection or ask a librarian; check the posted schedule before choosing a study window.
cards.short_summary: A public library stop inside the former McMurtrie Estate.
cards.evidence_claim: Huntingdon County Library lists public services and current hours Monday through Saturday; the borough identifies its location as 330 Penn Street.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–7 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: See the County Seat Up Close
cards.subtitle: Penn Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue along Penn Street to view the courthouse exterior, then use the county site if you need a specific office or service.
cards.short_summary: The county-government landmark anchoring the lower Penn Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Huntingdon County’s official website identifies the Huntingdon County Courthouse and gives the county address as 233 Penn Street.
cards.access_notes: County hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; office access may vary.

cards.title: Loop the Riverfront Park
cards.subtitle: Penn Street corridor beyond Smithfield Bridge
cards.notes: Follow Penn Street over Smithfield Bridge for the paved loop; keep to posted park hours and check conditions before using the pier.
cards.short_summary: A riverside park with a walking loop, skatepark, and fishing pier.
cards.evidence_claim: The Borough of Huntingdon says Portstown Park lies along Penn Street beyond Smithfield Bridge and features a paved walking loop, skatepark, and fishing pier.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; pavilion rental requires a fee, but general park use is public.

cards.title: Pause for Coffee or Tea
cards.subtitle: Mifflin Street corridor
cards.notes: Head down Mifflin Street for coffee, tea, smoothies, or café food; consult the current menu before deciding what to order.
cards.short_summary: A named café stop on the route between campus and downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Standing Stone Coffee Company’s official site identifies its café at 1229 Mifflin Street and publishes a café menu and current summer hours.
cards.access_notes: Current summer hours: Mon–Wed 7 a.m.–7 p.m.; Thu–Fri 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sat 7:30 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sun 9 a.m.–3 p.m.

cards.title: Check the Current Art Exhibit
cards.subtitle: 12th Street and Mifflin Street corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto 12th Street to see the current exhibit schedule; confirm whether a class or concert needs advance registration.
cards.short_summary: A converted church hosting exhibits, concerts, classes, and workshops.
cards.evidence_claim: The Huntingdon County Arts Council identifies the Arts Center at 313 12th Street and says it hosts exhibits, concerts, classes, and workshops.
cards.access_notes: Regular posted hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; individual programs may have separate schedules or fees.

cards.title: See Juniata’s Entrepreneurship Hub
cards.subtitle: Moore Street at 14th Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow Moore Street to view Juniata’s off-campus business center from the public approach; tenant offices are not general drop-in spaces.
cards.short_summary: A college-owned facility supporting local entrepreneurship and small businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College says the Sill Business Center sits along Moore Street at 14th Street and is designed to foster entrepreneurship and small-business growth.
cards.source_title: Sill Business Center at Juniata College
cards.access_notes: This is an active office and tenant facility; arrange access with a specific office rather than assuming public interior access.

cards.title: Choose Breakfast or Lunch
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Washington Street storefront corridor for breakfast or lunch; call ahead because the college advises checking local schedules.
cards.short_summary: A downtown café identified by Juniata as a breakfast-and-lunch option.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College’s local restaurant page identifies Wildflower Cafe at 516 Washington Street and describes it as serving breakfast and lunch.
cards.access_notes: Current operating hours were not verified on a direct business page; call before visiting.

cards.title: Grab a Slice or Sub
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue along Washington Street for pizza or subs; review the official menu and limited weekly schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A dine-in and takeout pizza shop on the downtown storefront corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: All American Pizza & Subs’ official site lists pizza, subs, dine-in and takeout at 612 Washington Street in Huntingdon.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Friday–Saturday 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. and Sunday noon–8 p.m.; Monday–Thursday closed.

cards.title: Order Pizza on Washington Street
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor at Seventh Street
cards.notes: Add this Washington Street storefront when pizza, subs, or pasta fit the plan; use the direct menu to check current choices and pricing.
cards.short_summary: An Italian takeout and dine-in destination near the Washington–Seventh corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Original Italian Pizza’s direct ordering site lists its menu and location at 628 Washington Street, Huntingdon.
cards.access_notes: The direct site publishes current ordering availability and full hours; verify them on the day of the visit.

cards.title: Catch the Pennsylvanian
cards.subtitle: Allegheny Street rail corridor
cards.notes: Finish near the Allegheny Street rail corridor for an intercity connection; check the live timetable and arrive before the scheduled train.
cards.short_summary: Huntingdon’s named passenger-rail stop on Amtrak’s Pennsylvanian route.
cards.evidence_claim: Amtrak’s May 9, 2026 Pennsylvanian timetable lists Huntingdon station code HGD as a daily stop in both directions.
cards.access_notes: The published timetable shows one daily train in each direction; verify live status and ticket requirements with Amtrak.
